scope: small superficial burn from heat, hot liquid, or steam on non-sensitive skin
response: For a small burn, cool it under cool running water for 20 minutes as soon as you can. Remove rings or tight items from the area before swelling starts. Cover loosely with a clean non-fluffy dressing or cling film. Do not use ice, butter, or toothpaste, and do not break any blisters.
red_flags: burn larger than the person's palm
deep, white, leathery, or charred skin
burn on the face, hands, feet, genitals, or a major joint
child or older adult with anything more than a very small burn
trouble breathing or hoarse voice after a smoke or heat exposure
